value.rationale: Nonsingularity and conditioning of the left/right preconditioned matrix are structural requirements for useful GMRES-IR corrections. A strict Frobenius residual decrease alone can defeat invertibility already in the minimal SPD dimension, and a nearby family has unbounded conditioning deterioration with uniformly bounded base/input condition numbers. This motivates safeguarding and distinguishes Frobenius approximation monotonicity from spectral robustness; no general speed benefit or finite precision claim is made.
